tooltip.lonya_plush.lonya_plush_doll: May there some memory of Lonya inside...?
tooltip.lonya_plush.controls: Place on blocks; click display to spin; sneak-click display to retrieve. Helmet/Curios compatible. Sneak-use in air to deploy; click companion to pat; Shift+right-click companion for retrieve/chat.
message.lonya_plush.full: Make room in your inventory first.
message.lonya_plush.owner: This doll belongs to another player.
gui.lonya_plush.title: Lonya Plush
gui.lonya_plush.visit_hint: Choose a chapter to visit Lonya. Your current chapter resumes where you left off.
gui.lonya_plush.visit_rules: Gain affection through daily chats, kind story choices and time with your companion. Chapters open in order; chapter 5 also needs the kind answer in chapter 4.
